channel.title: The Local Europe - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from The Local Europe (thelocal.com)

item.title: Swedish parliament committee rejects proposal to halt teen deportations
item.description: A Swedish parliament committee on Tuesday as expected rejected a proposal to freeze deportations of young adults.

item.title: More jobs are set to be cut in Switzerland in 2026
item.description: Over 2,000 more employees will lose their jobs, as yet another Swiss company announces a wave of redundancies.

item.title: Where are the US military bases in Spain and why are they there?
item.description: Spain's reluctance to allow the US to launch attacks on Iran from American military bases on Spanish soil has reawakened interest in the purpose of these installations, their location and their history.

item.title: Six in ten foreign doctoral students still in Sweden three years after graduating
item.description: Six out of ten foreign doctoral students stay in Sweden at least three years after graduating, but they struggle to compete with their Swedish peers on the job market.

item.title: Moderate youth leader confident of solution for Sweden's teen deportations
item.description: Douglas Thor, leader of the Moderate Party’s youth wing, raised the issue of unfair deportations long before it became a top political issue. He isn’t seeking credit – he wants a solution for those affected.

item.title: 'They're terrible': Trump threatens to cut all trade with Spain over Nato and Iran
item.description: US President Donald Trump threatened Tuesday to sever all trade with Spain after it refused to let US planes use its bases to attack Iran, while also lashing out at Britain for not cooperating more.

item.title: SKARS-GUIDE: Who's who in Sweden's Skarsgård acting dynasty?
item.description: Alongside Abba and Ikea, Oscar nominee Stellan Skarsgård and his many children are some of Sweden's most famous international exports. But who are they and what have you seen them in?

item.title: OPINION: Why Macron will not 'do a Chirac' over this Gulf war
item.description: As the US launches strikes against Iran, Emmanuel Macron's reaction has been very different to his predecessor Jacques Chirac, who refused to join the British and American invasion of Iraq in 2003 - John Lichfield examines why.

item.title: Why are so many EU citizens planning to leave Germany?
item.description: For the first time in 15 years, more EU citizens are leaving Germany than arriving. A new government study explains why.

item.title: Swedish games boss warns 'retroactive' citizenship reforms 'not good for industry'
item.description: Pushing through citizenship reforms without transitional rules will make Sweden less attractive to international talent, the acting head of the Swedish Games Industry Association has warned.
